title: Synchronous core with no I/O
description: Engineering consequence of WIT, WebAssembly Component Model IDL; QR Code Generation, 2.2 Choosing between a DVC and a VHL. QR Code Generation, 2.2 Choosing between a DVC and a VHL: “Works fully offline — Yes — verifier needs only the trust list”.

statements.label: Synchronous core with no I/O
statements.requirement: The pipeline core SHALL do no network or file I/O and SHALL NOT read an ambient clock. Trust material SHALL be loaded into a trust store by the host, and the current time SHALL be passed as an argument. Fetching, caching and refreshing trust lists SHALL live in separate, platform-specific modules.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-GEN-012 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-GEN-012 STT-VHL-010 STT-VER-009 the core does no network, file or asynchronous I-O` (ArchitectureTest.kt)).
